digest.component_or_area: CI evaluation harness for LLM provider matrix
propositions: A deterministic offline harness under tests/external/ must measure before/after raw-output distributions (prose vs fenced vs multi-object layout) across provider-model cells with current and sentinel directives, scoring parse success and layout-class rates on committed E2 reply fixtures.

The CI workflow (structured-output-baseline.yml) must enforce a predeclared per-run call budget (default 300 calls), skip unmeasured cells when provider credentials are absent, and upload raw replies and score table as artifacts without exposing API keys to shared hosts.

Unit tests must validate that the scorer reproduces exact golden counts on committed E2 fixtures, credential-absent cells record 'unmeasured' without failure, and the call-budget cap prevents execution before any network call.

The live workflow_dispatch run (30983268038) on all three provider arms (anthropic, bedrock, openai) completed successfully, confirming the sentinel directive raises parse success (8/20→11/20 for anthropic, 9/20→11/20 for bedrock) and collapses raw output to 100% prose layout on anthropic and bedrock.
